water.invalid: Invalid daily export. Check Date, Consommation, Index columns and unit.
water.empty: No readings available for this month.
water.inspect: Select a day to read its consumption.
water.setup_note: Connect your account to fetch available readings automatically. New readings update existing days.
water.saved: Readings saved. Charts are available in Energy.
water.account_note: Credentials stay in Moli’s encrypted vault. The last three months are fetched on connection, then refreshed every 12 hours. Readings are usually published the next day.
water.automatic_note: Tout sur mon eau readings refreshed every 12 hours. Days without readings remain unknown.
water.connection_failed: SUEZ is not responding. Saved readings are preserved.
water.login_failed: SUEZ refused the login or the session expired. Try again, then reconnect the account if it persists.
water.human_required: SUEZ requires human verification. Complete it on the SUEZ website, then reconnect the account in Moli.
water.data_failed: Unrecognized SUEZ response. Saved readings are preserved.
water.meter_required: Choose a meter identifier belonging to this account; automatic selection requires one meter.
water.meter_changed: This meter differs from the saved readings. No histories were mixed.
water.account_invalid: Enter a valid SUEZ email and password.
water.wait: Wait one minute before trying again.
